facts.fact: Article 384 of the Congolese Digital Code makes digital start-ups with entrepreneur status eligible for the tax, para-fiscal, customs and exchange advantages of the legislation on entrepreneurship and start-ups, per We are Tech.
The Minister of Digital Economy confirmed on 6 August 2026 that start-ups are not subject to the levies of the interministerial digital tax order of 20 July, which stays in force.

COD.note: No hub, incubator or park stated.
